name: Hunting and outdoor guide

pf.license.need: The hunter's own hunting license, tags and any hunter-education card are the hunter's, where the state requires them. The guide service's and the outfitter's own license, where the state requires one for guiding: the owner's papers, shown as given.
pf.license.who holds it: Each hunter holds their own license and tags. The guide and the outfitter hold their own papers, as the owner says.
pf.license.how it's checked: Not checked by Rosie, for the hunter or the guide. The owner keeps the papers. The hunter confirms the tags and season on the secure page (D96).
pf.license.insurance or bond: Liability insurance: the owner's own certificate, shown as given, never checked.
pf.license.blocks going live: Nothing: Rosie shows no license claim for any hunter or guide.
pf.license.renewals: The owner's own list; Rosie sends no reminder for a license it never checked.

pf.services.shape: a guided hunt, a sighting-in session and a planning meeting at the lodge (flow A: the hunter comes to the lodge or the range); a scouting day and a sighting-in at the hunter's own land (flow B: the guide goes to the customer)
pf.services.price kind: one price per hunt, per hunter, or per day, from the outfitter's own list; a travel fee on a home-land visit is part of the price shown
pf.services.examples: the example outfitter's own prices (Lee Outfitters, Lee Hunt Guides), not a standard

list.name: Guided half-day hunt, up to 2 hunters
list.length: half a day, out before sunrise or back before dark
list.after: the $300 rest paid at the lodge check-in, before the hunt

list.name: Scouting day on the hunter's land
list.where: at the hunter's own land (flow B)
list.after: the $260 rest charged to the saved card when the guide texts DONE

list.name: Sighting-in at the hunter's own range
list.before: a card saved for the $60 fee
list.after: the bill texted after the session

list.name: One-day rifle check at the hunter's place
Multi-day elk hunt, quoted from the plan
list.price: $1,200 quoted (over $500, so the owner OKs it)
list.where: from the lodge, several days (flow A)
list.before: a $300 deposit once the plan is signed

pf.services.never booked: No hunt for anyone who isn't allowed to hold a firearm under the outfitter's own rule, the state's rules, or the landowner's; no hunt on land without the landowner's permission; no hunt outside the season, the bag limit or the tags the hunter holds.
pf.services.capacity: one guide for up to 2 hunters; a hunt for more needs a second guide, booked by the owner
pf.services.online: Rosie never books a hunt for a child without an adult on the trip, and never records a call.

before times: What kind of hunt: deer, turkey, elk, birds, or a sighting-in only?
How many hunters, and the youngest's age (a youth hunt needs an adult)?
Does each hunter have their own license, tags and a rifle that's been checked?
Is it on the lodge's land, the hunter's own land, or another land with permission?
after a time is picked: Where to meet, and the road in
Clothing and a blaze colour, if the state asks for one
only on the secure page: The land's address and any gate code
The landowner's permission, if it's not the booker's land
Each hunter's name and tag number
Any medical needs or medicines on the trip
pf.questions.who may book: An adult hunter, or an adult who books for a hunter. A youth hunter books only with an adult on the trip. No one books a hunt on land the booker can't use.

words that stop a booking: someone shot, lost or hurt in the woods (call 911)
a gun pointed at a person or a threat with a weapon (call 911)
words that go on with safety steps: a hunter who has been drinking or is on a medicine that affects them: they don't hunt that day
a rifle that isn't safe to carry (it's checked at the range first)

what Rosie says.lost or hurt in the field: Call 911 now, and then the guide. Stay where you are if you're lost.
what Rosie says.drinking or impaired: The guide doesn't take that hunter out. The guide decides the money under the outfitter's own rule.

pf.safety.legal questions: Never answered: hunting, tags and season law is the hunter's own to follow; Rosie gives no legal advice.

prep for the reminder: Your hunting license, tags and any hunter-education card
Your rifle checked at the range before the hunt, if you're new to it
Blaze orange or the clothing the state asks for
A way to reach the lodge or the guide on the day

pf.visit.check-in: At the lodge: the code at the front desk. In the field: the code from the guide at the meeting point.
pf.visit.before the hunt: The guide checks each hunter's license and tags on the outfitter's own list, the rifles at the range, and the weather. Nothing is checked by Rosie.
pf.visit.work changes: A change on the hunt (a longer trip, a second day) is priced at the list price and OK'd by the hunter before it's done.
pf.visit.stops: A hunter who is unsafe with a rifle, or who breaks the outfitter's rules, is sent back to the lodge; the guide decides the money under the outfitter's own rule.
pf.visit.report: The hunt's notes and any game record go to the hunter on the secure page; the processor bills the hunter directly.

pf.money.before: a sighting-in paid in full; a guided hunt with a deposit; a scouting day with a deposit; a planning meeting with nothing taken
pf.money.after: the rest paid at the lodge check-in before the hunt, or charged to the saved card when the guide texts DONE, or the bill texted after a session
pf.money.cancel: a cancel in time gets a full refund; a late cancel or no-show keeps the deposit or the fee shown; weather can move the hunt for free
pf.money.caps: the owner's own limit: any quote over $500 is OK'd by the owner first
pf.money.tips: a tip for the guide is the hunter's choice, in cash at the lodge; Rosie never asks
pf.money.processing: game processing and taxidermy are billed by the processor to the hunter directly; Rosfield takes no money for them

plugin.pf.messages: Texts go to the adult who booked. Hunt details, tag numbers, medicines and any health detail are never in a text: the secure page only.

pf.staff.skills: guide (big game, upland birds, waterfowl), range instructor (sighting-in), lodge desk
pf.staff.licenses: the owner's own guide papers where the state requires them, shown as given
pf.staff.ratio: one guide for up to 2 hunters; a youth hunt is always one adult to one youth
pf.staff.standIn: any licensed guide on the team; nobody is booked by name
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs quotes over $500, any landowner question, and any refund

pf.rules.season: Only the state's own season, bag limit and the tags the hunter holds; the guide follows them, and Rosie doesn't check them.
pf.rules.weather: Weather can move a hunt for free; the guide decides, and the hunter picks a new day.
pf.rules.no tips asked: Tips are the hunter's choice; never asked.

pf.edges.walkins: A walk-in can sight in a rifle when the range has a free lane; else the next free day.
pf.edges.weather: A high-wind day, or a range closed for weather: a free move to another day.

notes: Hunting and outdoor guide (table style; from rentals; no sample, built for the rebuilt master, N4, Oct 27). Flow A (Lee Outfitters, the hunter comes to the lodge or range): a guided half-day hunt for up to 2, $450, a $150 deposit when booking, the $300 rest paid at the lodge check-in before the hunt ($150 kept on a late cancel); a sighting-in session, $60 a rifle, paid in full ($20 kept on a late cancel); a planning meeting at the lodge, free, nothing taken. Flow B (Lee Hunt Guides, the guide goes to the hunter's own land): a scouting day, $360, a $100 deposit, the $260 rest charged to the saved card at DONE; a sighting-in at the hunter's own range, $180 with the travel, a card saved for the $60 fee, the bill after; a one-day rifle check, $150 paid in full. Game processing and taxidermy are billed by the processor to the hunter, never through Rosie. Licenses, tags and cards are the hunter's own and the guide's papers the owner's, shown as given and never checked (D96). The season, bag limit and land permission are the hunter's to follow. A youth hunter always has an adult on the trip. Weather is a free move. $2 applies to every booking (D97). Sensitive off.
